text: In 2010, City Council approved the Chute Closure Program ('the Program') for multi-residential buildings in an effort to improve recycling rates and increase diversion at these buildings. In order to be eligible for the Program, buildings must meet the following minimum requirements: receive City of Toronto collection service; have sufficient space for storage of un-compacted waste containers on the property (if applicable); have sufficient space for storage of recycling containers on the property; and, have ordered, received, distributed and made residents aware of in-unit containers at least six months prior to the initial chute closure application. There are many multi-residential buildings throughout the city that do not receive City of Toronto collection service and are therefore ineligible to submit an application for the Program.
